title: Eligible Amount
description: The most that instruments of one item-restricted tender program may pay toward this checkout, as computed by the business.

program.description: The item-restricted program this amount applies to.

amount.description: Maximum combined contribution of instruments of this program, in minor units of the containing capability object's `currency`: the eligible lines after their discounts and any tax the program may pay, excluding fees, tips and fulfillment unless the program's rules allow them. Zero when no line qualifies.
